carbon-dioxide.basis: ideal gas; Shomate Cp in J/mol/K, t = T[K]/1000
carbon-dioxide.source: NIST Chemistry WebBook gas Shomate coefficients (Chase 1998); CODATA formation enthalpy

water.basis: ideal gas; Shomate Cp in J/mol/K, t = T[K]/1000
water.source: IAPWS R6-95(2018) eq. 5 and table 1; NIST-JANAF H-064 298.15 K entropy
water.note: Shomate fit; anchored at 298.15 K to formation enthalpy -241826 J/mol and entropy 188.834 J/(mol K); see analyses/mea_parameter_bundle/water-ideal-gas/fit.json.

nitrogen.scope: absorber gas-phase record only; not an Engine component
nitrogen.basis: ideal gas; Shomate Cp = A + B t + C t^2 + D t^3 + E/t^2 in J/mol/K, t = T[K]/1000
nitrogen.source: NIST Chemistry WebBook gas Shomate coefficients (Chase 1998)

oxygen.scope: absorber gas-phase record only; not an Engine component
oxygen.basis: ideal gas; Shomate Cp = A + B t + C t^2 + D t^3 + E/t^2 in J/mol/K, t = T[K]/1000
oxygen.source: NIST Chemistry WebBook gas Shomate coefficients (Chase 1998)

monoethanolamine.basis: ideal gas; Cp = a + b T + c T^2 + d T^3 in J/mol/K
monoethanolamine.source: Zhang, Que and Chen (2011), Table 3 (Aspen); uncertainty unreported
monoethanolamine.anchor_basis: h = s = 0 at reference temperature, moiety convention
